name: Regen
doc: Regen (the spell): the root and one director an action on its target - the two envelopes at its feet, the eight leaves with their trails, the sound; the status. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag147_regen.cpp) run on the program's memory (its packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: One director an action on its target: the two envelopes at its feet, the eight leaves with their trails, the sound; the status

params.label: Status tick
params.doc: The status (and the next action's director) at this tick

params.label: Leaf
params.doc: The sprite sequence leaf (a flipbook of 10 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Envelope model
params.doc: The prim model envelope (a mesh of 80 vertices, 64 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)
